lessons.title: Literary Genres & Epistolary Forms
lessons.teacher_notes: Deconstruct narrative sub-genres, epistolary fiction, bildungsroman progressions, and stylistic genre subversion.

lessons.title: Information Structure & Inversion Mechanics
lessons.teacher_notes: Master end-weight placement and syntactic inversion ('Seldom has a scientific discovery so profoundly reshaped...').

lessons.title: Poetics, Trope Analysis & Hermeneutics
lessons.teacher_notes: Analyze rhetorical tropes (synecdoche, zeugma, litotes, chiasmus), free indirect discourse, and hermeneutic criticism.

lessons.title: Ontology, Phenomenology & Epistemology
lessons.teacher_notes: Compare analytic language analysis with continental phenomenology, ontology, and existentialism.

lessons.title: Multi-Register Transformations (6 Registers)
grammar: Conversational vs Corporate vs Academic vs Journalistic vs Legal vs High Literary register shifts
lessons.teacher_notes: Execute seamless transformations of identical semantic content across 6 distinct communicative registers.

lessons.title: Statutory Drafting & Financial Game Theory
lessons.teacher_notes: Evaluate ratio decidendi in constitutional legal opinions, Nash equilibrium in game theory, and credit default swaps.

lessons.title: Quantum Mechanics & Genomic Sequencing
lessons.teacher_notes: Explore quantum entanglement, superposition in computing, CRISPR genome mapping, and neural plasticity.

lessons.title: Sentence Cadence & Corpus Mechanics
grammar: Alternating staccato vs periodic vs balanced sentences
lessons.teacher_notes: Master sentence cadence control, corpus-grounded native structures, and international English varieties.

lessons.title: Algorithmic Governance & Archival Historiography
lessons.teacher_notes: Analyze LLM benchmarking, algorithmic governance ethics, zero-trust cloud security, and historiographical revisionism.

lessons.title: Polyphony, Atonality & Structural Aesthetics
lessons.teacher_notes: Examine avant-garde musicology, chiaroscuro visual aesthetics, polyphonic composition, and museum curation.

lessons.title: Classical Loan Expressions & Etymology
grammar: Latin loan expressions (prima facie, de facto, status quo, ad hoc, vice versa, magnum opus, persona non grata)
French loan expressions (carte blanche, coup d'état, raison d'être, zeitgeist)
lessons.teacher_notes: Incorporate Latin and French loan phrases with native pronunciation, appropriate register, and semantic precision.

lessons.title: Fourth Estate, Spin Doctoring & Neuroplasticity
lessons.teacher_notes: Deconstruct political spin doctoring, manufacturing consent in broadcast media, and cognitive restructuring.

units.title: Diplomatic Tact, Cultural Allusions & Executive Leadership

lessons.title: Shakespearean Allusions & Mythological Metaphors
lessons.teacher_notes: Master Shakespearean idioms, classical Greek/Roman mythological metaphors, and cultural proverb allusions.

lessons.title: Executive Boardroom & Legal Opinion Writing
lessons.teacher_notes: Write formal legal opinions, statutory clauses, executive board white papers, and diplomatic policy directives.

lessons.title: High-Level Diplomacy, Tact & Prosodic Mastery
lessons.teacher_notes: Master unconstrained rhetorical persuasion, subtle diplomatic dissent, sardonic wit, and near-native prosody.
